title: Ningbo Surnano Aerogel Co., Ltd. | China Aerogel Manufacturer
content:
Ningbo Surnano Aerogel Co., Ltd. is a one-stop aerogel solutions manufacturer based in Ningbo, Zhejiang. The company markets itself as a technology-oriented producer with deep aerogel process experience, serving industrial insulation, construction, mobility, and specialty thermal-management applications.

Company Overview

Surnano promotes a broad product family that includes aerogel blankets, pads, powders, coatings, boards, and pipeline-cover systems. Its official site highlights service to oil and gas, construction, renewable energy, rail transit, and new-energy vehicle sectors, supported by in-house R&D and advanced production lines.

Coverage and Focus

  • Coverage Area: China and international export markets.
  • Focus Areas: One-stop aerogel solutions for oil & gas, construction, new-energy vehicles, renewable energy, rail transit, and technical textiles.

Main Products and Capacity

  • Aerogel blankets and pads
  • Aerogel granules and powders
  • Aerogel boards and paints
  • Aerogel fabrics, mortar/concrete systems, and pipeline covers
  • Public Capacity: 5 million sqm of high-performance aerogel-related products annually.

Production Sites and Certifications

  • Main Production Site: Science and Technology Innovation Park, No. 262 Binhai 4th Road, Hangzhou Bay New Area, Ningbo, Zhejiang, China.
  • International Certifications: ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, and IATF 16949.
  • Official Website: https://china-aerogel.com
